cases.text: To the chief musician; of David. In Yahweh I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flutter {like} a bird to your mountain.
For the chief musician; of David The fool says in his heart, “No God.” They are corrupt, they do a deed abominably. {There is} none doing good.
A psalm of David Yahweh, who may sojourn in your tent? Who may dwell on your holy mountain?
A miktam of David. Protect me, God, for I take refuge in you.
A prayer of David Listen, Yahweh {to} righteousness. Pay attention to my cry! Give ear to my prayer from lips without deceit.
A psalm of David Yahweh is my shepherd; I will lack nothing.
A psalm of David To Yahweh {is} the earth and its fullness, the world and the ones dwelling in it.
Of David To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
Of David Vindicate me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity, and in Yahweh I have trusted without wavering.
Of David Yahweh is my light and my salvation; whom will I fear? Yahweh is the refuge of my life; whom will I dread?
Of David To you, Yahweh, I cry; my rock, do not be deaf to me, lest you be deaf to me, and I be equal with those going down to the pit.
A psalm of David Ascribe to Yahweh, sons of God, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
A maskil of David The happinesses of the one whose transgression is lifted up, the one covered from sin!
Of David Yahweh, oppose my opponents; fight those fighting me.
Of David Do not be upset about evildoers; do not be envious of the doers of unrighteousness.
A Psalm of Asaph The God of gods, Yahweh, has spoken, and he has summoned the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.
For the chief musician; a song; a psalm. Shout to God, all of the earth!
Of Solomon. God, give your judgments to the king and your righteousness to the son of the king.
A psalm of Asaph Surely God is good to Israel, to those with a pure heart.
A maskil. Of Asaph. Why, God, have you rejected {us} forever? {Why} does your nose smoke against the flock of your pasture?
A maskil of Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people; incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
A psalm. Of Asaph. God, nations have come into your inheritance; they have defiled the temple of your holiness; they have made Jerusalem into heaps.
A psalm. Of Asaph. God is standing in the congregation of God; in the midst of gods he judges:
A prayer. Of David. Incline your ear, Yahweh; answer me, for I {am} poor and needy.
Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. A song. His foundation {is} on the mountains of holiness.
A psalm. Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things; his right hand and the arm of his holiness have brought him salvation.
A psalm of thanksgiving. Shout to Yahweh, all the earth.
A psalm of David I shall sing {of} covenant faithfulness and justice; to you, Yahweh, I shall sing praises.
Of David Bless Yahweh, my soul! And all of my inward parts, the name of his holiness.
To the chief musician: a psalm of David. God of my praise, do not be silent!
Of David, a psalm. The declaration of Yahweh to my lord {the king}: “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”
A song of ascents. To Yahweh, in the distress to me, I called, and he answered me.
A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the mountains. From where does my help come?
A song of ascents; of David. I rejoiced in the ones saying to me, “Let us go {to} the house of Yahweh.”
A song of ascents. To you I lift up my eyes, the one dwelling in the heavens.
A song of ascents; of David. If not Yahweh who was for us— let Israel indeed say—
A song of ascents. Those trusting in Yahweh {are} like Mount Zion; it will not be shaken; forever it abides.
A song of ascents. When Yahweh returned the captivity of Zion, we were like ones dreaming.
A song of ascents; of Solomon. If Yahweh does not build a house, {in} vain its builders have labored on it. If Yahweh does not watch a city, {in} vain the watchman has stayed awake.
A song of ascents. The happinesses of everyone fearing Yahweh, the one walking in his ways.
A song of ascents. Abundantly they have afflicted me from my youth. Let Israel indeed say:
A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to you, Yahweh.
A song of ascents; of David. Yahweh, my heart is not high and my eyes are not raised up, and I do not walk in great and marvelous {things} beyond me.
A song of ascents. Remember, Yahweh, for David, all of his afflictions,
Of David I will thank you with my whole heart; before the gods I will make music to you.
For the chief musician; of David; a psalm. Yahweh, you have searched me and you know {me}.
A psalm of David Yahweh, I cry out to you, “Hurry to me! Give ear to my voice when I cry out to you.”
A psalm of David Hear my prayer, Yahweh; listen to my pleas! On account of your faithfulness answer me in your righteousness!
Of David. Blessed {be} Yahweh, my rock, the one teaching my hands for war, my fingers for battle,
A psalm of David. I will exalt you, my God, the King, and I will bless your name forever and ever.
This is a note for the worship leader: This is a psalm of David. I trust that Yahweh will protect me. So do not say to me, “You need to escape to the mountains like birds do,

This is a note for the worship leader: This is a psalm of David. {Only} foolish people say to themselves, “There is no God!” People who say those things do corrupt deeds; they do detestable deeds; hardly anyone does what is right.
A psalm of David. Yahweh, who is allowed to enter your sacred tent? Who is allowed to live on your sacred mountain?
A song of David. God, protect me, because I go to you to keep me safe!

A prayer of David Yahweh, listen to me while I plead with you to act justly toward me. Hear me while I call out to you to help me. Pay attention to what I say while I pray because I am speaking honestly.
A psalm of David Yahweh {cares for} me {like} a shepherd {cares for his sheep}, {so} I {know that I} will have everything that I need.
A psalm of David The earth and everything in it belongs to Yahweh. All the people in the world belong to him too,
A psalm of David Yahweh, I come to you in prayer and tell you all that I need.
A psalm of David Yahweh, show that I am innocent. I have done what is right, and I have trusted in Yahweh without doubting him.
A psalm of David Yahweh encourages me and nourishes my inner being. He is the one who saves me, so I will not fear anyone. Yahweh is the one to whom I go for refuge, so I will not dread anyone.

A psalm of David Yahweh, I call out to you. You are like a huge rock {on top of which I am safe}. Do not refuse to answer me because if you refuse to answer me, I will soon be with those who are in their graves.
A psalm of David You heavenly beings, praise Yahweh! Declare that he is very glorious and powerful.
A song of David Those whom God has forgiven for rebelling against him, and those whose sin God has atoned for, these are the ones who will have a truly good life!
A psalm of David. Yahweh, be the enemy of my enemies! Defend me against those who attack me!
This is a psalm of David. Do not let what wicked people do upset you; do not wish that you had what people who do evil things have.
A Levite from the clan of Asaph wrote this song. Yahweh is the only true God. He has decreed that people from all over the world should come to him.
This is a note for the worship leader: This is a song, a psalm. Everyone on earth should shout joyfully to praise God!
A psalm of Solomon. O God, please enable the man who is now succeeding his father as king to judge cases rightly, as you would do.
Asaph wrote this psalm. God truly is good to us Israelite people, to those who want to do what pleases God.

A Levite from the clan of Asaph wrote this song. God, it feels as if you have permanently abandoned us! You care for us Israelites the way a shepherd cares for his flock. So please do not continue to be angry with us.
A song of Asaph. My friends, listen to what I am going to teach you; pay careful attention to what I will say.

A Levite from the clan of Asaph wrote this song. God, foreign nations have invaded the land that belongs to you. They have made your holy temple unfit for worship, and they have made Jerusalem a pile of ruins.
A Levite from the clan of Asaph wrote this song. God has taken his place in the assembly that he governs; he pronounces judgment on the rulers there.
A prayer of David. Yahweh, I am poor and helpless, so please do what I ask.
One of the Korahites wrote this song. Yahweh established his city on mountains that he made holy.
A psalm. Sing to Yahweh a new song because he has done wonderful things! By being powerfully holy he has saved {his people}.
A psalm of thanksgiving. Everyone in the world should shout joyfully to Yahweh!
David wrote this psalm. Yahweh, I will praise you with singing! I will sing that you are just and that you faithfully love us.
A psalm of David I tell myself, “Praise Yahweh!” To everything that is within me, I say, “Praise him because he is holy!”
A note to the worship leader: David wrote this psalm. God, you are the one whom I praise, so please answer my prayer
David wrote this psalm. Yahweh said to my lord, “Sit {here,} close to me, in the place of highest honor until I completely defeat your enemies and make them {like} a stool for your feet!”
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. When I was distressed, I called out to Yahweh, and he answered me.
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. I look toward the hills {and I ask myself,} “Where will anyone to help me come from?”
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. This is a psalm of David. I was very happy when people said to me, “We should go to Yahweh’s temple {in Jerusalem}!”
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Yahweh, I look up toward you who live in heaven.
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship; of David. If Yahweh had not been helping us— All Israelites should repeat this—
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. People who trust in Yahweh are as secure as Mount Zion, which will stand firm forever.
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. When Yahweh brought us back to Zion after our enemies had captured us {and taken us away}, we felt as if we were dreaming.

This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. It is of Solomon. If people are building a house, but Yahweh does not approve of it, those who build it are doing nothing useful. If Yahweh does not protect a city, it is useless for the guards to stay awake watching it.
This is a psalm for those going up to the temple to worship. How good life is for all who deeply revere Yahweh and who do what he tells them to do!
A psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Ever since I was young, my enemies have oppressed me frequently. All of the people of Israel should say this {with me}:
This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Yahweh, I am very distressed, so I call out to you.

This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. It is a psalm of David. Yahweh, I am not a proud, haughty person. I do not concern myself with things that are too great or too amazing for me.
This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Yahweh, think about {King} David and the many ways that he suffered.
This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. It is of David. Think about how wonderful and delightful it is when God’s people live together {in a unified way}!
This is a psalm for people going up to the temple to worship. Listen! Praise Yahweh, all you who serve Yahweh, you who stand in Yahweh’s temple during the night hours.
This is a psalm of David. Yahweh, I sincerely thank you. In the presence of {idols of} other gods, I sing to praise you.
This is a note for the worship leader: This is a psalm of David. Yahweh, you have thoroughly examined me, and you know {me completely}.
This is a psalm of David. Yahweh, I call out to you; please help me quickly! Please listen to me when I am calling out to you.

This is a psalm of David. Yahweh, please listen to me as I pray to you, pleading for you to help me! Because you are righteous and because you faithfully do what you have promised, please do what I am asking you to do for me!
This is a psalm of David. I praise Yahweh, who protects me! He equips me to fight well in wars.
This is a psalm of David. My God and king, I will proclaim that you are very great; I will praise you now and always.
